def solution():
    # Define variables
    qualified_expenses = 8500
    magi = 85000
    filing_status = "individual"

    # Calculate the credit before and after the MAGI phase-out
    eligible_expenses = min(qualified_expenses, 10000)
    potential_credit = eligible_expenses * 0.20
    phase_out_factor = (90000 - magi) / (90000 - 80000)
    credit = potential_credit * phase_out_factor

    # Return the answer to two decimal places
    return round(credit, 2)
